incidents.name: Munchables LockManager rogue-developer proxy drain
incidents.notes: A contracted developer who controlled the LockManager's ProxyAdmin upgraded the proxy to an implementation he wrote and pre-credited his own address with 1,000,000 ETH of locked balance, then withdrew 17,413.96 ETH of real user deposits; the audited game logic itself was not defeated.

sources.ref: onchain review: LockManager EIP-1967 proxy 0x29958e8e4d8a9899cf1a0aba5883dbc7699a5e1f created 2024-03-21 by 0xc207fa4b17ca710ba53f06feff56ca9d315915b7 (not the attack sender 0x6e8836f050a315611208a5cd7e228701563d09c5); two Upgraded events, the last on 2024-03-21T23:58:39Z to the unverified implementation 0xf563ce437e3ab8e0b79585df5122700fbc42afcd that was live during the drain; the withdrawal call carries 0x3b0033de4e2bd540000 = 17,413.96 ETH. All funds were returned when the developer handed over keys.
